# Parts verdict /2 producer fixture

Producer: `rig-c/review` at schema-final merged head
`07c07d254725c97cfc63aa7b028cb8ef8ccf9045` (review#389), package version 1.6.0.
Source: `src/parts-view.ts` (`loadPartsView`, `saveVerdict`, `readVerdict`),
`src/parts-comment-crops.ts` (`preparePartsComment`), and `src/parts-comment.ts`
(`PartsComment`). No verdict was hand-written or edited after saving.

From create, with that detached review checkout's frozen dependencies installed:

```sh
bun tests/generate-parts-verdict-v2.ts <review-checkout> <fresh-output-dir> --check
```

The generator sets `RIG_REVIEW_STATE_DIR` to `<fresh-output-dir>/state` and fixes
only the clock to `2026-11-05T12:00:00.000Z`. Both outputs are produced through
`saveVerdict` and validated through `readVerdict`: `evidence/parts-review.json`
(no comments) and `evidence/parts-review-comments.json` (one prepared comment).
`derived/` is copied unchanged from the synthetic `rig-review-1.5.0` fixture.
The viewport crop uses synthetic PNG bytes, not a browser capture. The native
crop is generated by review's own preparation function. `state/comment-crops/`
retains both crops for producer read-back; create does not read this state.

The generator checks the detached head before importing producer code and
refuses an existing output directory. `--check` compares every generated file
byte for byte to this fixture. It runs only when explicitly invoked, so normal
consumer tests require no sibling checkout or external producer source.
